note: ramps: median NAIP RGB of slope > 8 deg, non-dark pixels per 0.25 m elevation bin in a 300 m window. r2_* = share of colour variance explained by elevation alone (flat strata). Shading (west-facing slopes 15 % darker, morning image) dilutes raw RGB; with redness chromaticity R/(R+G+B) and a planar dip of up to 3.4 deg fitted per window, elevation explains 0.54 (astrobiology banded hills, 100 m window), 0.33 (same, 300 m), 0.70 / 0.44 (38.413 N -110.786 E, 100 / 300 m), 0.37-0.60 (mounds at 38.414-38.415 N), but only 0.12-0.27 on the unbanded badlands at 38.410 N -110.7965 E and 0.17-0.23 at 38.399 N -110.790 E. Fitted dips often hit the search limit, so dip direction is not reported.
